sampling: Calendar dates fixed before V3 changes, never selected by algorithm score or future outcome. Insufficient coverage stays explicit; no invented candles or replacement by successful cases.
blind_view: Closed OHLC only through as_of. No algorithm output, future candles, correctness hints or expected labels. Case IDs do not encode a predicted regime.
labels: User annotations independent of algorithm predictions; not an independently adjudicated expert benchmark. No labels are available at registration.
freeze: Explicit user action validates required annotations and binds labels to case hashes. Export canonical frozen bundle with SHA-256. Predictions and comparisons remain separate. Revisions create a new version, never edit a frozen benchmark silently.
metrics: Exact-event precision/recall with labeled completeness scope, TP/FP/FN and explicit null for absent denominator; narrative agreement/confusion, target eligibility agreement, WAIT fraction. Unlabeled cases never count as negatives. No TP probability or profitability claim.
walk_forward: Chronological expanding prefixes; parameter fitting disabled. Label freeze must precede comparison. Genuine out-of-sample claim additionally requires untouched non-overlapping evaluation cases and independent review.
readiness: Research components assessed separately. Decision Support remains unvalidated until label comparison, adjudication and fresh verified market data. Live Execution is always disabled.
